about: Preloaded models for AuditGym. Auditors are training runs (20 numbers each plus their curves); local LLMs are pulled through Ollama.

models.name: auditor-cem
models.title: General auditor (recommended)
models.description: Trained with CEM on mixed companies. Reads every table and runs all four checks; matches the hand-written Reconciler on the test set.

models.name: auditor-cem-interacting
models.title: Auditor for interacting errors
models.description: Trained only on companies whose errors interact (the brief's hardest cases).

models.name: auditor-reinforce
models.title: REINFORCE auditor
models.description: Trained with the policy-gradient method instead of CEM: noisier, weaker. Useful to compare methods.

models.name: auditor-noise-control
models.title: Untrained control (noise instead of reward)
models.description: The same training, but the search saw random noise instead of the reward. Shows what the auditor does without learning: the gap to the others is what training adds.

models.name: qwen2.5-0.5b
models.title: Qwen2.5 0.5B (local LLM)
models.description: Smallest local language model, about 400 MB, via Ollama. In the app: Runs → LLM or LLM + tools. Measured on the test set: −0.50 alone, −0.33 with tools.

models.name: qwen2.5-1.5b
models.title: Qwen2.5 1.5B (local LLM)
models.description: Small local language model, about 1 GB, via Ollama. Measured on the test set: −0.60 alone, −0.09 with tools (precision 0.88).
